page.biography.title: About Artiani
page.biography.body:
Artiani is a father-and-son collaboration — a shared vision by artist Levan Margiani and Giorgi Margiani, inspired by Levan’s miniatures and by the desire to bring art closer to people.

Here, selected works by Levan Margiani take on a new, tangible form: tablecloths, runners, decorative pillows, headscarves, and other objects created for the home. This is not simply printing on fabric. It is an attempt to give Levan Margiani’s works new life — to bring them into everyday spaces and allow art to become a quiet atmosphere and part of daily experience.

Each piece is created with respect for the spirit of the original work — preserving its symbolism, warmth, rhythm, and emotion. What begins as miniature becomes atmosphere; what once lived on the wall begins to live beside us.

Artiani invites art out of the frame and into life — closer, more tangible, and more alive.
